meta.name: ladder-quality-order
meta.description: Loss-2 judge (codex role). Over one topic's 6 shuffled research-design samples, pairwise-rank by quality using the D1–D5 standard. Emit the pairwise log; the harness computes the order and the ladder verdicts. Judge quality difference, never against academic standards.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对研究设计样本进行质量排序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按标准对研究设计进行质量排序。
copy.tagline_en: Rank research design samples by quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pairwise-rank research designs by quality standards.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会要求你对 6 个研究设计样本（每个含研究图和结果）进行成对质量比较，基于 D1–D5 标准选出更好的那个，最终得到质量排序报告。
howto.when: 当你提供 6 个研究设计样本并请求按质量排序时触发。

say.text: 请比较样本 0 和样本 1，哪个质量更高？
say.note: Claude 将输出赢得比较的样本编号和理由。

say.text: 请对这 6 个研究设计进行质量排序。
say.note: Claude 会启动成对比较流程，逐一询问你。

howto.what_en: Claude will ask you to pairwise-rank 6 research design samples (each with a research graph and result) by quality using the D1–D5 standard, and produce a quality ordering report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide 6 research design samples and request a quality ranking.

say_en.text: Compare sample 0 and sample 1: which is higher quality?
say_en.note: Claude will output the winner and reason.

say_en.text: Please rank these 6 research designs by quality.
say_en.note: Claude will start pairwise comparisons, asking you each time.
